messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — we have a customer spike causing 5xxs and long tail latencies. Seeing repeated request hangouts in the dequeue stage :grimacing:
Maria G: Which cluster/tenant? any error patterns in gateway logs? :eyes:
Samir: Tenant 8921 (BrightDoc). Gateway shows timeouts at the gateway->batcher handoff. Logs show continuous-batcher backlog growing past config depth.
Alex W: Sample log from gateway at 17:02:23:
```
ERROR gateway request=0x7f2a tenant=8921 proto=rest status=504 msg="dequeue timeout" queue_depth=512 max_depth=500 backlog_ms=12000
```
Maria G: Wait queue_depth > max_depth — sounds like our protection didn't trigger early reject. Could be the depth check isn't applied for this request path.
Jordan S: I'm seeing a similar trace in the batcher: `batcher: enqueue_time=170ms dequeue_time=24000ms continuous=true threads=8` — KV cache warmup upstream maybe blocking dequeue.
Samir: Repro steps I ran locally (short):
1) Hit /v1/generate with 5 requests concurrently with long context (~4k tokens).
2) Observe `continuous=true` batcher entries stacking due to KV cache miss + quantized model slowdown.
3) After ~20s, gateway returns 504.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"open-xyz","input":"<long prompt>"}'
```
Alex W: Customer reports spikes from cron jobs at 02:00 UTC, but our telemetry shows sustained small bursts across the hour. Might be accumulation effect in continuous batching.
Elaine P: Config check: dedicated pool uses `queue.max_depth=500`, `dequeue.timeout_ms=10000`. If backlog_ms hits 12000, we should have early-failed. Why didn't early fail?
Samir: Possible cause: the new routing policy to fallback model variants bypasses the normal queue depth enforcement when migrating requests between variants. Looking at the router code now.
Maria G: Can you grep for `should_early_reject` in router? Also check the feature flag `enable_variant_routing_v2`.
Jordan S: Quick mitigation: reduce `queue.max_depth` to 200 for the affected pool and lower `dequeue.timeout_ms` to 6000 to force earlier shedding. Will that be acceptable for BrightDoc?
Alex W: Do it as a temporary mitigation. Samir/Elaine, can you coordinate a config change and a canary rollout? Maria, please notify support and the customer that we're investigating and doing mitigations.
ops-bot: deploy started by Jordan S for pool=dedicated-us-east-2 config: {"queue.max_depth":200,"dequeue.timeout_ms":6000} — rollout 20%
Samir: Pushed a small router patch to add an extra depth check on variant route path. Will open PR and link.
Maria G: Customer message drafted: "We're seeing request congestion that can cause timeouts; we're deploying mitigations now (reduced queue depth and earlier shedding) and investigating router routing enforcement. Sorry for the disruption." :pray:
Alex W: Post-deploy metrics (5m after): backlog_ms dropped from 12k -> 1.2k, 5xx rate down 78%. Latency p99 improved but still slightly above SLO.
Elaine P: Follow-ups: 1) Add unit test for variant routing depth enforcement. 2) Add alert for queue_depth > 80% of max for longer than 2m. 3) Schedule postmortem if customer impact > 15 minutes.
Jordan S: I'll own the immediate alerts change. Samir take the PR and tests. Maria will handle the customer comms and escalation notes.
Samir: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/PR-4789 — adds `router.should_reject_on_depth()` call on variant path and a small perf guard.
Maria G: Filing support ticket with BrightDoc now and linking this thread.
Alex W: Thanks team. Retrospective items: investigate KV cache warmup patterns for long contexts and consider prefetch heuristics or short-circuit for very long context requests. Marking this resolved for now after mitigation. :thumbsup:
Maria G: Closing loop with customer in 30m and then reopen if recurrence.
Samir: I'll follow up with a repro script and include perf counters so SRE can replay.
Jordan S: Nice work.
Elaine P: Logging the incident for postmortem.
ops-bot: incident annotated: severity=sev2 impacted_customers=[8921] mitigation=queue-config-rollout 
Alex W: End of thread.
